packageRules.description: Wait 7 days before taking a new action release (supply-chain cooldown).

Cargo.lock can only be regenerated after prepare.sh has written prepared/ from the upstream/ submodule, which Renovate does not run: list cargo updates on the Dependency Dashboard instead of opening PRs whose lock file is stale. Update locally with `sh prepare.sh && cargo update -p <crate> && scripts/cargo-sources.sh`.
These follow the pinned Tuta SDK, not this repository: tuta-sdk links uniffi at the same revision (one scaffolding ABI), and crypto-primitives takes our rand_core::OsRng. They move with upstream/.
